nodes.name: Rust Basics
nodes.description: Master Rust fundamentals: variables, mutability, functions, and control flow. Learn the syntax and basic patterns that form the foundation of Rust programming.
learning_objectives: Understand Rust variable binding and mutability
Apply pattern matching to simple types

nodes.name: Ownership & Borrowing
nodes.description: Dive into Rust's unique ownership system. Understand memory management without garbage collection through ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes.
learning_objectives: Prevent data races at compile time

nodes.name: Structs & Enums
nodes.description: Create custom data types with structs and enums. Learn how to model domain concepts, implement methods, and use pattern matching effectively.
learning_objectives: Define custom structs with named fields
Use pattern matching with match expressions
Work with Option<T> for nullable values
